integrity: At fixed total, Gini ordering is reduced exactly to the household-income range and Theil ordering to the integer key product x_i^{x_i}. All three-part positive integer partitions through total 13 are generated independently in two ways, while the infinite family is proved by a monotone logarithmic-ratio argument with an exact base case.
scientific_limitations: The sharp minimum is for three-household positive rational equal-total distributions after primitive integer scaling. It measures lattice complexity, not the intrinsic size of a monetary unit. The result concerns strict reversal between the relative Gini coefficient and Theil's T only.
title: The smallest primitive three-household Gini–Theil reversal has total income thirteen
